mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 20 trading days signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline by >1% over the 20-day horizon, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, raising risk perceptions and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 5.0% but 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the effect reverses within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not rise over the 20-day horizon, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.62%), rising interest rates reduce the present value of future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 3.62% for 60 days but 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the regime transitions before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index above 95.3 (2005-09-01 revised value) indicates expanding supply conditions, reducing production costs and boosting corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 95.3 but 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the effect reverses within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside expanding industrial production (INDPRO) signals a robust economic environment, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO does not rise over the 20-day horizon, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment (UNRATE) alongside falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signals easing labor market pressures and accommodative monetary policy, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market easing and monetary accommodation
failure_condition: Either UNRATE or FEDFUNDS does not decline over the 20-day horizon, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase, a CPIAUCSL index below 200 (indicating low inflation) supports sustained economic growth and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL remains below 200 for 60 days but 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the regime transitions before the horizon.
